title: [main][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextVATEntryNo to OnAfterGLFinishPosting in Code
summary: The OnAfterGLFinishPosting event in the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit now includes a NextVATEntryNo variable parameter, allowing event subscribers to access the next VAT entry number during posting.
key_points: Added NextVATEntryNo variable to OnAfterGLFinishPosting event
Change applied across all localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO, RU)
Enables event subscribers to reference the next VAT entry number
Small code change replicated consistently across regional variants
